notes: Ttool is now Ashlight, and your settings come with it. Game profiles switch your colour, crosshair and more when a game is in front. Settings backups: daily, before big changes, and save or open them as a file. Crosshair codes to copy and paste a look. Suggest something from Settings and see when it's accepted. Chat keeps up after a lost connection: missed messages, unsent ones and calls come back by themselves. Safer: Windows settings are put back even if Ashlight crashes.
